project_name: Grego Infortech - Zen Cyberpunk Landing Page

design_philosophy.core_concept: Presença Calma (Calm Presence) in a Chaotic Digital World
design_philosophy.visual_style: High-contrast Dark Mode with tactical Neon accents

typography.heading_style: Bold, Tight tracking (-0.02em), Uppercase for small labels
typography.instructions: Import 'Syne' (400, 700, 800) and 'Manrope' (400, 500, 600) from Google Fonts. Use Syne for all Headings (h1-h3) and Manrope for body text. NOTE: If Space Grotesk is preferred for a more 'tech' feel in headers, it is acceptable here despite the general ban, as it fits the specific brand identity, but Syne is the E1 recommendation for uniqueness.

colors.usage_rules: Backgrounds must be #050505. Cards use #0A0A0A with a 1px border of white/10. Neon colors are for Accents, Buttons, and Hover states only. Never use neon for body text.

layout.grid_system: Bento Grid (Mode A) for Services. Asymmetric column layouts for Vision.
layout.spacing: Generous. Use p-8 to p-16. Gap-8 minimum for grids.

buttons.primary: Solid Neon Green (#39FF14) background, Black text, Sharp edges (rounded-sm), font-bold, hover:scale-105 transition-transform
buttons.secondary: Transparent background, Neon Blue (#00F0FF) border, Neon Blue text, hover:bg-neon-blue/10
buttons.social: Icon-only or Text+Icon, minimal, high contrast on hover

cards.style: Glassmorphism Lite. bg-white/5 backdrop-blur-md, border border-white/10. On hover: border-neon-green/50 and slight glow.
cards.feature_card: Must use the 'Tracing Beam' effect (animated border) on hover.

navigation.style: Floating, blur-backdrop. Logo 'GI' on left, Links center, 'Fale Comigo' (LinkedIn) CTA right.
navigation.mobile: Hamburger menu with full-screen dark overlay

hero.layout: Centered text or Left-aligned with abstract 3D element on right.
hero.content: Headline: 'Tecnologia com Presença Calma'. Subheadline: 'Infraestrutura que funciona sem pânico'.
hero.background: Abstract Green Neon Lines (Image 1) with low opacity overlay.

vision.layout: Split screen. Image on one side, text on other. High contrast.

services.layout: Bento Grid. 4 items. Mix of square and tall cards.

cta_final.layout: Minimalist centered. Large typography. Direct links to LinkedIn.

animations.reveal: Framer Motion: fade-in-up with stagger for lists.
animations.hover: Glow effects on cards. Text color shift to Neon Green.

effects.noise: Add a subtle SVG noise overlay fixed to the screen at 3% opacity to reduce digital flatness.

universal_guidelines: Do NOT use gradients for text. Keep text solid White or Grey for readability.
Do NOT use standard Shadcn cards without heavy customization.
Ensure 4.5:1 contrast ratio for all text.
Mobile First: Stack grids to 1 column on mobile.
No Contact Form - Only Social Links.
instructions_to_main_agent: 2. CONFIGURE Tailwind with the Neon palette and fonts (Syne, Manrope).
3. CREATE the 'GI' Logo as a text component using 'Syne' font with a neon glow (text-shadow).
4. BUILD the sections sequentially: Hero -> Vision -> Services -> Approach -> Result -> Positioning -> CTA.
5. MOCKUP Social Links: LinkedIn (https://linkedin.com/in/gregoinfortech - mock), Instagram (https://instagram.com/gregoinfortech - mock).
